summary: D003 strengthened P0002 by adding a physical tide staff / pier / inspection-office pressure, but it still read too much like a verified source table with lyric bridges.
findings: The bench-mark/staff location was the best material advance over D002.
The seven datum lines and extrema sequence produced more compliance than poetic pressure.
The validation gate itself was partly complicit because it rewarded literal survival of too many source facts.
The next revision should compress source facts into the packet and surface only anchors that make the measurement problem readable.
recommended_revision: P0002-D004 should use anchor/context source compression: source packet remains dense and auditable; poem surface becomes less table-forward.
